title: finding(types,plugin-kanban): `ColumnWidthConfig` / `ColumnWidthConfigSchema` are published with zero readers and no schema key that references them (objectui#8522 removed the last reader)
body:
Filing-gate category: ③ a trap (class c): a published authoring type with nothing behind it. An author, or an AI, can build a `ColumnWidthConfig` and nothing will ever read it. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#8522 dev report and contract review (PR objectui#10549, which retired `useColumnWidths`). Recorded on ACCEPT `5829536633`: "the ruling did not reach the type". ⛔ Not graded here.

## Fact (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

`git grep ColumnWidthConfig` over the tracked tree, excluding markdown, finds only declarations, re-exports and ledgers:
- `packages/types/src/complex.ts:~274`: `export interface ColumnWidthConfig { defaultWidth?; minWidth?; maxWidth?; overrides? }`. Its neighbouring docblock (~:249–252) already says "The one `plugin-kanban` reader of {@link ColumnWidthConfig} was removed by objectui#8522, whose ruling did not reach the type itself";
- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts:~155`: `ColumnWidthConfigSchema`, the mirror;
- re-exports at `packages/types/src/index.ts:~342`, `packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts:~271` and `packages/plugin-kanban/src/index.tsx:~197` (via `./types`);
- ledgers: `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` and `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`.

No schema key references it. The kanban arm's `columnWidths` key was retired by objectui#8802 (`complex.zod.ts:~91`), so no document can carry one, and no component reads one.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- This is the ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove question on a type with no key and no reader. Startup-stage policy defaults to retiring immediately.
- Removing a published export means `Clause-②: yes`, and a `minor` changeset for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/plugin-kanban`.
- ⚠️ `complex.zod.ts` is a hot file held by another seat's work (objectui#9306 / #10478): serial.

## Dedupe

They are the seat post, objectui#8932 (`KanbanEnhanced.tsx`, a different file retirement that names the type in passing) and PR objectui#10549 (the origin). None is this card.
